verdict.line: You lose reps where you facetank Test of Spirit and Harsh Lesson poke for free; you win by shoving to her E cooldown and all-inning at 4 passive stacks.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's real threat is her Tentacles, and Prophet of an Elder God only spawns them on nearby impassible terrain, so away from walls she is just a melee duelist with a 4-second Harsh Lesson leap and a 16-12s Test of Spirit spike. Irelia's Ionian Fervor rewards patient spell-poke into a timed all-in, which lines up exactly with the windows Illaoi's cooldowns leave open.

theirWindow.when: her E (Test of Spirit) just landed on you
theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately instead of trading — standing in range while the spirit is out lets nearby Tentacles and her follow-up hits echo damage back onto you.

yourWindow.when: you're at 4 Ionian Fervor stacks and her E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage now. Chain E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Bladesurge (Q) in for the reset — her Test of Spirit being down removes her only real burst answer.

start.why: Run in 91% of games (53% win rate) — the sustain and AD offset Harsh Lesson (W) poke that lands every 4 seconds.

boots.why: 86.8% pick rate at 52% win — Illaoi is entirely physical damage between Tentacles, W, and her R, so flat reduction beats Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: First-item in the 21.4%-pick, 60.7%-win path — the on-hit % max HP damage punishes her high base HP without needing to out-tank her.
Second item in the same measured path — the empowered auto adds burst to your post-stun all-in window.
Closes out the top-picked build path — magic damage and attack speed scale directly off Ionian Fervor stacking.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the top page (40.8% pick, 53.4% win) — stacks build during the extended trades this lane forces, and the healing on full stacks directly counters the healing Illaoi's Tentacles give her on champion hits.

summoners.why: 92.7% pick rate at 51.7% win — this is a skirmish-heavy melee duel decided by short trade windows, and Ignite closes out the all-in once your E (Flawless Duet) stun lands.

playing.title: Punish Her Cooldown Windows
playing.detail: Track her E (Test of Spirit, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) on cooldown timers. When it's down she loses her main burst tool, so shove and threaten Bladesurge (Q) picks.

playing.title: Leave the Spirit Immediately
playing.detail: If she lands E on you, back off rather than trading — damage dealt to your spirit echoes back onto you, and any nearby Tentacles will also swing while it's active.

playing.title: All-in at 4 Passive Stacks
playing.detail: Per the measured matchup data, commit your all-in once Ionian Fervor (Passive) is at max stacks for the attack speed and bonus on-hit damage, then chain into E (Flawless Duet)'s stun.

playing.title: Fight Away From Walls
playing.detail: Prophet of an Elder God (her Passive) only spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain — pull trades toward river or lane center, away from tri-brush and wall segments.

playing.title: Respect Harsh Lesson Poke
playing.detail: W (Harsh Lesson) is only a 4-second cooldown leap that also triggers nearby Tentacles. Don't stand still and eat repeated pokes between your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Charge W to Eat a Poke
playing.detail: Defiant Dance (W) reduces physical damage taken while charging — hold the charge to absorb an incoming Tentacle Smash (Q) or Harsh Lesson before you commit your combo.

playing.title: Wall Off Her Escape With R
playing.detail: Vanguard's Edge (R) marks on hit and leaves a slowing wall behind it — save it to cut off her retreat right after your E (Flawless Duet) stun lands.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read on how those numbers play out in lane.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Close in to engage whenever Irelia has 4 stacks [P] prepared.
